context: This criteria evaluates whether the solution correctly uses request.defaults() to create a configured request instance that automatically applies preset options to all subsequent requests.

checklist.name: defaults() usage
checklist.description: Uses request.defaults() to create a new request function with preset options

checklist.name: baseUrl configuration
checklist.description: Configures baseUrl in defaults to handle relative URLs automatically

checklist.name: Shared headers
checklist.description: Sets default headers that are automatically included in all requests from the instance

checklist.name: Method chaining
checklist.description: Uses HTTP method shortcuts (get, post, put, delete) on the defaults instance

checklist.name: Override capability
checklist.description: Demonstrates that individual requests can override default options when needed
